{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "purpleKarrot",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected that passing two arrays requires two full copies of the UTXO set and will not scale, preferring a lookup abstraction"
    },
    {
      "login": "ismaelsadeeq",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "approach and code review ACK after initial design moved away from requiring block undo data"
    },
    {
      "login": "alexanderwiederin",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "advocated for the callback design and successfully tested rust-bitcoinkernel bindings against it"
    },
    {
      "login": "w0xlt",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Approach ACK initially, but objected to script check cache poisoning and process crashes on coins with invalid confirmation heights"
    },
    {
      "login": "17031996",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "left an empty review comment"
    },
    {
      "login": "yuvicc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK"
    },
    {
      "login": "ajtowns",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to caller-provided lookup callbacks over determinism concerns and requested an in-memory CCoinsView container that exposes UTXO deltas"
    },
    {
      "login": "nervana21",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but noted that calling ConnectBlock inherits assumevalid and bypasses script checks for ancestor blocks"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "left review comments and test suggestions without taking a stance on the approach"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5033101292",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "flattening coins into two arrays and converting them into an ephemeral map requires two full copies of the UTXO set and will not scale to production",
      "quote": "While this approach may serve as a proof-of-concept, it will not scale to a production application.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to callback approach for fetching coins",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5204246251"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5204246251",
      "status_by_quote": "Switched to callback approach for fetching the coins"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5204427745",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "a caller-supplied lookup callback allows non-deterministic lookups across calls and fails to capture the resulting UTXO set changes",
      "quote": "I think we should control the container ourselves, rather than using a lookup(outpoint) -> coin callback that the caller provides so that we can be sure the lookups are consistent across calls.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3970483852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ancestor blocks under assumevalid will skip script checks during validation instead of running full validation",
      "quote": "When we call ConnectBlock on a main chain block that is an ancestor of the assumevalid block (and satisfies some other straightforward criteria), we inherit assumevalid logic and omit script checks.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5824099852",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ValidateBlock caches successful script checks in m_script_execution_cache without committing to the spent coins, allowing caller-supplied forged coins to validate and later cause the node to connect an invalid block",
      "quote": "ValidateBlock() can make the node connect an invalid block.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "author suggested clearing the cache or requiring genuine coins; w0xlt noted clearing still allows hits from an already populated cache and needs refinement",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5829114150"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5836264573",
      "status_by_quote": "the solution suggested above also needs refinement: it prevents new entries from being stored, but still allows hits from an already populated cache"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5824444513",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "ValidateBlock can crash on an assertion failure in release builds when validating a transaction with a BIP68 relative lock if a caller-supplied coin has a confirmation height at or above the block height",
      "quote": "ValidateBlock() can crash on a coin with an impossible confirmation height.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "author suggested documenting the height requirement; w0xlt pushed back that documenting still leaves an avoidable crash",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5829114150"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5836264573",
      "status_by_quote": "Just documenting the height requirement still leaves an avoidable crash."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4358903754",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",

  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "address the cache poisoning vulnerability and coin height crash bug raised by w0xlt, as well as outstanding objections from ajtowns and nervana21",
      "id": "c:5836264573"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added w0xlt's objection regarding release build crashes caused by coins with impossible confirmation heights. The author proposed addressing both this and the script execution cache poisoning issue via documentation or cache clearing, but w0xlt pushed back on those resolutions, leaving both issues contested."
